title: The last R&D agent behind the chat: the orchestra spike as a command
request: The owner's goal: every agentic system in R&D works behind the chat; the 28.1 spike was the only one explained, not reached.
plan: a command line for the spike in R&D: start, answer, confirm; rules only; its files in a folder given

decisions.decision: a command the person approves, not a chat tool
decisions.why: a replaced prototype; the product's understanding team stays the chat's tool
its checkpoints and events never land in the person's workspace by accident

change: R&D dclab_rnd/orchestra/spike.py (main), tests/test_orchestra.py; dclab-code sync/agents.json, docs.

findings.defect: the spike does not flag a column known only after the prediction moment
findings.scenario: bank marketing predicted before the call: duration not flagged as a leak
findings.cause: the spike's summary carries no leak list (a prototype)
findings.fix: none in the spike: the understanding team, which replaced it and catches such leaks, is the chat's tool; said in the docs

measurements.name: live
measurements.gate: the walk runs from the chat to a confirmed end, files only in its folder
measurements.result: two questions, confirmed; R&D's tracked files unchanged; $0.11

outcome: All 18 of R&D's agents are reached from DCLab Code's chat (7 tools, 6 routes, 5 commands); none only explained.
lessons: Reaching a replaced prototype shows why it was replaced: run it live before calling it obsolete.
risks: the spike misses leaks; it must not stand in for the understanding team
